note: Support = raw input-column coverage only, never a claim that a branded metric is reproduced.

box_only_value_index (APPROX, not BPM/EP.why: Full box (min/pts/reb/ast/stl/blk/tov/fg/ft/pf/plus_minus) present, 0% missing. Transparent linear weights only -- no RAPM target to fit against.

on_off_differential (unadjusted precurso.why: plus_minus + min present per player-game; already built as atlas_player_usage_role.on_off_net_diff. Labeled unadjusted/biased, not RAPM.

box_rate_now_cast (per-36, DARKO-lite BO.why: Per-36 rate stats computable directly from min + counting stats. NOT a claim of DPM/DARKO -- box rates only.

playmaking_creation_profile (APPROX).why: ast/tov/fga present but no potential-assists, passes-made, or touches -- creation volume only, not quality.

shot_selection_descriptor (zone-baseline.why: Makes/attempts by 2/3 present so rim-vs-3 rate and eFG% are computable, but no shot-location/zone/distance column -- no true zone baseline.

gravity_proxy (CV subset only).why: Needs broadcast-CV defender-distance tracking; this parquet is box-score only. CV coverage is a separate 241-game/17,254-row/252-player subset -- flag cv_coverage, do not extrapolate league-wide.

lineup_synergy (descriptive, unadjusted).why: No on-court lineup / stint identifier column in this table.

aging_curve.why: No birthdate/age column; only 3 season snapshots (2023-24..2025-26) -- too thin even if age were derivable.

RAPM/xRAPM/EPM/DARKO-DPM/LEBRON/BPM/RAPT.why: Do-not-fake list: all require a league-wide RAPM target or continuous tracking data we do not have. Never reproduce or label as these metrics.
